# Gillian Parkinson F.

> Gillian Parkinson Farfán is a bilingual (English/Spanish) operating partner and fractional COO who works alongside founder-led businesses to improve operations, develop teams, strengthen marketing, and identify new revenue opportunities.

35+ years inside businesses across 14 countries. Based in Philadelphia, PA. Every engagement starts with a 30-minute Strategy Call. The full site is available in English and in Spanish (/es/).
